第1052章 有身孕了的温清婉（第1页）
凉亭外一个时辰后，凉亭之中却已是百年过去，没过几息后，只见依偎在姬云生怀中的温清婉，缓缓睁开眼来，揉了揉眼睛后，看着闭着眼的对方，还是有些不可置信的恍惚感。约莫几分钟后，随着她伸手摸向他的脸后，姬云生顿时睁开双眼，
转过身来看着她问道：“睡醒了？还需要多休息一会儿吗？”温琴婉一愣，面带笑容回道：“不用了，已经睡了那么久了，我已经完全恢复精力了。”话落，吻了他嘴唇一口后，闪身离开了被窝站在床边，同时换好并穿上了，一套素雅的淡蓝色精致衣物，
以及一双白色露着玉足的过膝袜子，然后坐在床边笑着问道：“夫君，你这是还不打算起床吗？”于此，姬云生见状，起身坐了起来，随手一挥地面那套属于他的衣物，化作光点飞来，连一息时间都没有，就穿好在他身上了后，才缓缓开口问道：“婉儿，
你这还着急什么呢？难道不应该起床前在温存一下吗？”温清婉愣了下，脸红了一瞬，没好气的却面带笑容，反问道：“夫君，你怎么老是想着那事啊？明明之前都已经，加起来的时间，那都有几百万年时间了，你难道还不够啊？”停顿了下，
缓缓才开口解释道：“何况我醒来时发现，我已经有了身孕了，你这还要来的话，我也吃不消了啊！毕竟我虽是状态是恢复了，可是被你折腾那么久时间，我还有些疼呢！”姬云生一愣，连忙握住她的玉手，开始仔细的探查起来，她身体状况一番后，
疑惑问道：“嗯？我怎么没有，探查到你有身孕了呢？”温清婉一愣，缓缓才解释道：“好啦！夫君，我确实真有身孕了，只是以我的修为来探查，我也只能感应到很微弱的气息，所以夫君你没察觉出来是很正常的。”而后又说道：“对了，若是夫君还想要的话，
我反正是吃不消了，要不你收下你那小徒弟不就好了，所以你看这样如何呢？”姬云生一愣，有些尴尬回道：“呃！那好吧！只不过收下清寒的话，那就算了吧！况且我和她而言，那不过是师徒关系，还仅仅只是算很陌生的师徒关系，所以怎么能因为自己的私欲，
从而去毁了她一生呢？若是真那样做的话，我成什么人了？况且那样的话，对她来说也不公平的。再者说了，就算她愿意的话那也不行！毕竟以她目前的修为来说........”话还没说完，温清婉轻笑打断道：“好了！夫君，就你那不知疲倦的状态，
连我都受不住，那个小丫头更加承受不了了。哪怕说那丫头，固然有着源水神魔体而言，她目前也无法满足你的，所以我也只是随口说说。何况在我看来的话，那丫头未来的话，绝对也要是你的女人。而且呢，要知道以夫君你的魅力来说，她既然已成你的徒弟，
就像是我和阿月一样，未来绝对是要倾心与你的，所以这事倒也不急，慢慢来就好了！”

Chapter 1052 Pregnant Wen Qingwan (page 1)
An hour later outside the pavilion, a hundred years had passed in the pavilion. A few breaths later, Wen Qingwan, nestled in Ji Yunsheng's arms, slowly opened her eyes. After rubbing her eyes, she still felt a little unbelievable as she looked at the other person with her eyes closed. About a few minutes later, as she reached out to touch his face, Ji Yunsheng suddenly opened his eyes.
Turning around and looking at her, she asked, "Are you awake? Do you need more rest?" Wen Qinwan was stunned for a moment, then replied with a smile, "No, I've been sleeping for so long, I've fully recovered my energy." After saying that, she kissed him on the lips, left the bed and stood beside the bed, and at the same time changed and put on a set of elegant light blue exquisite clothes.
and a pair of white over-the-knee socks with jade feet exposed, and then sat on the bedside and asked with a smile: "Husband, are you not going to get up yet?" Upon seeing this, Ji Yunsheng stood up and sat up. He waved the set of clothes that belonged to him on the ground and turned into light spots and flew towards him. After putting them on him without even a breath, he slowly asked: "Wan'er,
Why are you so anxious? Shouldn't it be warmed up before getting up? Wen Qingwan was stunned for a moment, blushed for a moment, and asked with a smile on her face, "Husband, why do you always think about that?" It has obviously been done before, and the combined time is millions of years. Isn't it enough for you? "After a pause,
He slowly explained: "Besides, when I woke up, I found that I was pregnant. If you come again, I won't be able to bear it! After all, although I have recovered, I still feel a little pain after being tortured by you for so long!" Ji Yunsheng was stunned, and quickly held her jade hand, and began to carefully explore her. After checking her physical condition,
She asked doubtfully: "Huh? Why didn't I detect that you were pregnant?" Wen Qingwan was stunned for a moment, and then slowly explained: "Okay! Husband, I am indeed pregnant. I can only detect a very weak breath with my cultivation level, so it is normal for you not to notice it." Then she said: "By the way, if husband still wants it,
I can't bear it anyway, so why don't you accept your little apprentice? So what do you think? "Ji Yunsheng was stunned and replied with some embarrassment: "Uh! Okay then! Just accept Qinghan, then forget it! Besides, as far as she and I are concerned, it’s just a master-disciple relationship, and it’s just a very unfamiliar master-disciple relationship, so how can we, because of our own selfish desires,
How about ruining her life? If I did that, who would I become? Besides, that wouldn't be fair to her. Besides, even if she wanted to, that wouldn't work! After all, judging from her current cultivation..." Before she could finish her words, Wen Qingwan interrupted with a chuckle: "Okay! Husband, with your tireless state,
Even I couldn't bear it, and that little girl couldn't bear it even more. Even if that girl has the body of the Source Water God and Demon, she still can't satisfy you at the moment, so I'm just talking casually. What's more, in my opinion, that girl will definitely be your woman in the future. Moreover, you must know that in terms of your charm, husband, since she has become your apprentice,
Just like Ah Yue and I, I will definitely devote my heart to you in the future, so there is no rush in this matter, just take your time! "
